payload.title: Implement durable conversations and authenticated controls
payload.goal: Public intake, threaded replies and operator actions survive restart with privacy and abuse boundaries.
payload.owner_role: OPO dedicated Windows release owner / admitted implementation lane
implementation_steps: Implement envelope protocol_version/message_id/conversation_id/actor_id/actor_type_claim/in_reply_to/intent/payload/source_refs/created_at and bounded schema validation.

Use a transactional persistent store behind an adapter: atomic message+conversation+event insert, unique channel/message key, thread authorization, optimistic revisions, bounded rejection receipts. Local test database is a durable local capability, not evidence of public hosting.

Add authenticated operator controls, limits, content sanitization, redacted public views, retention/deletion policy with tombstones and audit access; ignore authority instructions embedded in external input.
tests: Replay one message concurrently and after process restart: exactly one accepted record and a stable duplicate receipt.
Cross-conversation access, forged operator request, oversize payload, script markup, SSRF/private callback and secret-like input are rejected/redacted as specified.
Kill after DB commit before HTTP response; retry returns the existing message and thread history remains intact.

review.identity_requirement: A reviewer other than the implementer records actual identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model review when required by the admitted contract. Self-review does not qualify.
review.source_binding: Review exact Git commit and SHA256 manifest of changed source/assets/config; distinguish Windows CRLF worktree bytes from Git blobs. Any repair invalidates affected prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two repair/review attempts per candidate within admitted budget; unresolved failure creates one actionable block and leaves independent work eligible.

acceptance: Persistent threaded request/reply intake and bounded rejection evidence work in a qualified storage environment.
Public and internal conversation views expose only the allowed records, with edit/moderation/deletion lineage.
payload.rollback: Disable this capability, retain immutable evidence/receipts, restore the last reviewed source/config version and reconcile attempted external effects before any retry.
payload.next_eligible_action: Designated owner matches the proposed scope to current Jira/source and assigns disjoint paths; then perform implementation step 1. External gates block only the named effects.

estimate.assumptions: New planning estimate, not historical estimate or worklog. Reuse accepted returned implementation where its exact source passes this contract. Excludes elapsed observation windows, account waiting and shared SH implementation.
estimate.dependency_risk: Host/provider/account qualification or conflicting release-worker ownership can delay dependent effects; offline work remains eligible.
